messages:
Emily P (Partnerships): Quick sync 12hrs before CloudCon7 - partner cohosting a mini-stage. Need: speaker confirmation, demo reliability plan, swag manifest + on-site pickup. Anyone free to triage?
Raj S (Events): I can lead speaker ops. Can we lock mic check + arrival window? propose 9:20am arrival for partner speaker, 9:50am mic check.
Janine (Sales): I'll own the marketplace slide and a 1-line CTA for leads. Also can supply two tablets for quick lead capture.
Marco G (Eng): For the demo I'll build a 90s live path and a 60s pre-recorded fallback. Live uses HW device with local weights; fallback uses hosted API.
Tom O (Ops): Fallback checklist: 1) pre-record clip on booth laptop, 2) static QR to clip + lead form, 3) network routing to hosted API if device offline.
Lorna (Logistics): Swag manifest from partner: 100 tees, 200 stickers, 30 powerbanks. Courier ETA Thu 18:05. Customs sometimes holds powerbanks, fyi.
Emily P (Partnerships): If powerbanks are held, what's plan? any non-battery freebies we can swap?
Lorna (Logistics): Swap plan: extra shirts + stickers we keep in locker. Venue locker can hold overflow.
Marco G (Eng): Health-check on demo laptop will flip to fallback automatically. Command: `curl -fsS http://localhost:9000/ready || ./play_fallback.sh`
Raj S (Events): Can you add that to the runbook and add a boolean flag so stage AV can override if needed?
Marco G (Eng): Yep. Will add manual "force_fallback=true" in the runbook config.
Janine (Sales): For the slide, can we include a small "Try it in Marketplace" badge and a short promo code? I have a partner promo code ready.
Emily P (Partnerships): Perfect. Ask partner to send final deck by Tue EOD. Also need a speaker bio (one para) for the emcee.
Raj S (Events): Pinged partner: requested deck + bio + onsite contact. @EventBot reminder: submit AV deck by Tue noon.
EventBot: Reminder  Submit AV deck to AV team by Tue 12:00 to avoid encoding issues.
Tom O (Ops): AV note: bring HDMI dongles (USB-C, MiniDP) and a spare clicker. Also bring a travel router for fallback hosted API hotspot.
Lorna (Logistics): I'll coordinate courier to deliver 1 box to main desk and rest to locker. If customs delay > 30m we proceed with fallback.
Marco G (Eng): Small risk: local weights need USB passthrough. If customs holds USBs then live won't run. Confirmed fallback path will work without USBs.
Janine (Sales): Lead capture: use simple Google Form + short code on tablet. I'll sync the form with Sales CRM after the event.
Emily P (Partnerships): Run-of-show (tentative): 10:00 intro, 10:03 speaker talk, 10:05 live demo (90s), 10:07 Q&A + partner table redirect. Keep demo tight.
Raj S (Events): Suggest mic check at 9:50, team gather at 9:30 for final brief. I'll post a reminder in #all-hands on day-of.
Tom O (Ops): I'll reserve locker #3 and set access code; adding to runbook.
Lorna (Logistics): Confirmed courier new ETA Thu 17:50. If delayed, we execute fallback plan.
Marco G (Eng): I'll open a tiny repo with the fallback script + clip upload. PR coming: https://git.internal/partner-demo/fallback (will paste PR once ready).
Janine (Sales): Partner contact on-site? we need mobile + point person for swag signoff.
Raj S (Events): On-site contact: Sofia M (+1-415-555-0147), arriving 9:30 per partner.
Emily P (Partnerships): Final checklist to tick off before leaving: partner deck received, prerecorded clip uploaded to booth laptop & cloud, health-check script deployed, locker reserved, QR+lead form live, swag manifest confirmed, onsite contact mobile in runbook. Mark when done.
Marco G (Eng): Will deploy health-check and upload clip by Mon EOD.
Janine (Sales): I'll finish lead form and ship tablets by Wed.
Lorna (Logistics): I'll confirm courier drop and locker assignment by Wed noon.
Raj S (Events): I'll confirm speaker travel window and mic check time.
Emily P (Partnerships): Thanks team. Closing thread after runbook update :thumbsup:
